text:
October 14, 2026
To,
The General Manager,
National Stock Exchange of India Limited
Exchange Plaza, Bandra-Kurla Complex,
Bandra (East), Mumbai-400051.
Symbol: SAHANA
Subject: Clarification / Intimation regarding inadvertent transmission / circulation of Unapproved Draft Postal
Ballot Notice by Service Provider today i.e. October 14, 2026.
Dear Sir/Madam,
With reference to the captioned subject and in furtherance of our prior intimation regarding the meeting
of the Board of Directors scheduled to be held on Friday, October 16, 2026, we wish to bring to your immediate
attention an operational clarification concerning an inadvertent communication transmitted earlier today,
October 14, 2026.
In line with standard secretarial preparedness and solely to ensure operational readiness for seamless
execution subject to Board approval, an unapproved working draft a email for the proposed Postal Ballot Notice
was shared with the e-voting service provider, strictly for advance configuration, system testing, and operational
readiness purposes.
Due to an unintended operational lapse at the service provider’s end arising from an administrative
miscommunication between the teams regarding test parameters, the said unapproved draft communication was
prematurely and inadvertently dispatched to shareholders today, October 14, 2026, without the authorization,
concurrence, or final clearance of the Company.
The Company unequivocally clarifies to the stock exchanges, shareholders, and the investing public that:
 Only an electronic mail containing indicative/test links and reference to a draft postal ballot notice was
prematurely circulated by the service provider, which has neither been approved by the Board of Directors
nor uploaded on the website of the Company or submitted to the Stock Exchange as a sanctioned notice.
 The proposed preferential issue and related matters have neither been considered, evaluated, nor approved
by the Board of Directors of the Company.
 The Board of Directors retains complete fiduciary discretion to consider, modify, defer, or reject the proposed
matter at the scheduled Board Meeting on October 16, 2026.
 The communication circulated inadvertently does not constitute a valid, sanctioned, or effective Notice
under Section 110 of the Companies Act, 2013, read with the applicable rules, and carries no legal force.
The Company has taken up the matter with service provider to ensure that any associated links/system processes
remain strictly suppressed, disable, inactive, and recalled. The Company is in the process of issuing a direct
advisory to all shareholders requesting them to completely disregard and ignore the said email
inadvertently circulated by service provider.
Should the Board of Directors approve the proposed matter at its meeting on October 16, 2026, a duly
approved Postal Ballot Notice, along with comprehensive disclosures and voting schedules, shall be issued and
disseminated in strict compliance with applicable statutory provisions.
The Company regrets the procedural inconvenience caused to its stakeholders due to this operational
error is sincerely regretted. We request you to kindly take the above on record and disseminate the information
to all concerned stakeholders.
Thanking you,
For Sahana System Limited

Ramjibhai

 Arham Technologies Commences Brand Marketing Campaign for
STARSHINE Featuring Brand Ambassador Vicky Kaushal

Raipur, 15th October 2026: Arham Technologies Limited (NSE-SME: ARHAM), a consumer
electronics brand and manufacturer under its flagship brand STARSHINE, has commenced
its brand marketing campaign featuring Bollywood actor Vicky Kaushal. The brand
marketing campaign commenced during first day of Navratri as part of Arham
Technologies’ efforts to strengthen STARSHINE’s brand presence. As part of the ongoing
campaign, Mr. Kaushal shared the STARSHINE television advertisement on his official
Instagram handle yesterday, further extending the campaign’s reach and visibility across his
digital audience.
Click here to watch the Advertisement: Link
The campaign marks an important step in Arham Technologies' ongoing efforts to
strengthen STARSHINE's brand identity and expand consumer awareness across India.
The Company has consistently highlighted brand building as a key focus area, alongside
expanding its product portfolio and distribution reach in the consumer electronics market.
Through its association with Vicky Kaushal, STARSHINE aims to build stronger brand
recognition and connect with a wider consumer base. The campaign is intended to
complement the Company's distribution network by providing dealers and distributors with
greater brand visibility and marketing support, particularly in Tier 2, Tier 3 and Tier 4
markets, where consumer awareness and brand recall can play an important role in
purchasing decisions.
Mr. Ankit Jain, Executive Director and Chief Financial Officer, commented, “As we had
outlined during our fundraise last year, building and strengthening our own brand has been a
key part of our long-term vision for STARSHINE. Appointing Mr. Vicky Kaushal as the brand
ambassador was an important step in that direction, and we are now moving ahead with
actively leveraging this association through our brand marketing initiatives. His reach and
recognition provide us with an opportunity to create stronger brand impressions and improve
STARSHINE's visibility among consumers. We also see this as an important support for our
dealers and distributors, who can leverage greater brand awareness in their respective
markets. Our objective is to continue investing in STARSHINE's brand presence and build a
stronger connect with consumers across India.”

Arham Technologies Limited is a leading Electronics Manufacturer and Original Equipment
Manufacturer (OEM) specializing in Smart LED Televisions under the premium STARSHINE

company operates from the Electronic Manufacturing Cluster in New Raipur with State-OfThe-Art facilities including 1K standard clean rooms and advanced testing protocols. The
company has established itself as a dominant player in Central India's consumer electronics

Date: 15th October, 2026
To,

NSE Symbol: PARTH
Subject: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 – Receipt of New
Domestic Orders Aggregating to Approximately ₹85 Crore
Dear Sir/Madam,
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations,
2015, as amended, we are pleased to announce that Parth Electricals & Engineering Limited has
secured new domestic orders aggregating to approximately ₹85 Crore (excluding GST) from various
reputed EPC contractors in Gujarat for the manufacturing and supply of Ring Main Units (RMUs),
which will be installed across Gujarat's electricity distribution network.
KEY BUSINESS HIGHLIGHTS
New Order Wins: Approximately ₹85 Crore (excluding GST)
Total Executable Order Book: Approximately ₹471 Crore as of 15th October 2026
Product Segment: Ring Main Units (RMUs)
Customer Market: Gujarat's electricity distribution sector
Execution Period: Commencing within 2 months, with completion over the following 12 months.
STRONG MANUFACTURING VISIBILITY
With these new orders, along with existing orders on hand, the Company has a combined RMU order
pipeline of approximately 2,500 units. This is expected to provide a substantial base load for the
Company's existing of RMU manufacturing facility in Vadodara over the next 12 months, supporting
capacity utilisation and operational planning.
STRATEGIC GROWTH OPPORTUNITY
The strong domestic order pipeline is expected to enable the Company to focus on Value added
orders while creating opportunities to utilise its new manufacturing facility at Khordha, Odisha, to
serve customers in the eastern regions of India.
MANAGEMENT OUTLOOK
The latest order wins reinforce the Company's presence in the domestic power distribution and
electrical infrastructure sector. An executable order book of approximately ₹471 Crore provides

 encouraging business visibility over the coming 12–14 months, subject to project schedules,
execution, and other applicable conditions.
The Company remains committed to timely execution, operational excellence, and the highest
standards of quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.
The above information is being disclosed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations
and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended.
Kindly take the above information on record.
Thanking you,
Yours faithfully,

Dear Sir/Madam,
Sub: Receipt of certified true copy of the final order by the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal,
Mumbai Bench (‘Hon’ble Tribunal’) in the matter of Scheme of Merger by Absorption of Oilmax
Energy Private Limited (‘OEPL’ or Transferor Company’) with Asian Energy Services Limited (‘AESL’
or ‘Transferee Company’ or ‘the Company’) and their respective shareholders (‘Scheme’).
This is with reference to our earlier communication dated Wednesday, September 30, 2026, regarding
the sanction of the Scheme by the Hon'ble Tribunal under Sections 230 to 232 read with Section 66
and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 (‘Act’) and the Companies (Compromises,
Arrangements and Amalgamations) Rules, 2016 (‘the Rules’) made thereunder.
In this regard we wish to inform you that today on Thursday, October 15, 2026, the Company has
received the certified true copy of the final order pronounced by the Hon'ble Tribunal after its hearing
held on Tuesday, September 29, 2026.
A copy of the said final order is enclosed for your records and is also uploaded on the website of the
Company.
We request you to take the above on record and disseminate the same on your website.
Thanking you,
Yours sincerely,
For Asian Energy Services Limited
